components.gap: The precedence and association ranks of the Part 8 temporal and epistemic operators do not reach the passages where those logics are presented, so the U-unfolding axiom is not licensed where it is stated. The rows of next, until, eventually and always (symbols.csv:94-97) carry the scope "Parts 8-9 from conditionals-deontic-free". The rows of K_i, E_G, C_G, B_i and D_G (symbols.csv:98, 100-101, 540-541) carry the scope "P8 conditionals-deontic-free". Both are named scopes rebound from the legacy numeric P8.3 in registry/symbol-scopes.json, and their reader regions begin at sec:p08-conditionals-deontic-free (Part 8 chapter 3). They exclude ch:modal-temporal-epistemic (chapter 2), which contains the LTL language (restoration/inherited-13340-13409.tex:1-8), its Hilbert calculus with the U-unfolding schema A U B <-> B v (A ^ X(A U B)) (restoration/inherited-13410-13439.tex:5-12), the LTL completeness section sec:p08-linear-temporal-completeness (parts/p08/linear-temporal-completeness.tex), CTL (parts/p08/temporal-epistemic-supplement.tex) and S5n epistemic logic with K_i, E_G and C_G (restoration/inherited-13479-13518.tex, inherited-13519-13551.tex). By the preamble of def:p01-w02-p01-024-fixity (024:2913-2915) the convention applies "only to operators whose recorded scope contains the passage". No rank or association therefore licenses these readings, and the U-unfolding example def:p01-w02-p01-024-rank-examples item 1 (024:3052-3061) cites a section outside the scope of the rows it relies on. In the same way, the modal operators box, diamond, [m] and @_i in the annex proofs handbook/annex/p08/sources/src-025-501.tex (for example 806-825 and 1147-1160) and the box in parts/p08/inquisitive-propositional.tex:837-842 lie outside every rank-bearing scope. The box and diamond rows (symbols.csv:91, 93) do not reach these passages, and items 3, 10, 11 and 21 of def:p01-w02b-p01-012-p8-readings hold only in the body sections. Ranks and association must apply in these passages. This is writable: add in-scope rows to the packet's intake CSV and state the readings in the owned convention. Rebinding the legacy scopes in registry/symbol-scopes.json is lead-owned.
